key: Hello! Welcome to the Onyx Arcade!
en: Hello! Welcome to the Onyx Arcade!
ja: こんにちは! オニキスゲームセンターへようこそ!

key: Unfortunately, our player versus player systems are currently offline due to a system virus, but please feel free to enjoy the rest of our features!
en: Unfortunately, our player versus player systems are currently offline due to a system virus, but please feel free to enjoy the rest of our features!
ja: 残念ながら、システムウイルスの影響で対戦システムは現在停止していますが、他の機能はぜひお楽しみください!

key: Hello! Welcome to the Onyx Arcade, now fully operational!
en: Hello! Welcome to the Onyx Arcade, now fully operational!
ja: こんにちは! 全機能が復旧したオニキスゲームセンターへようこそ!

key: This is the Pokémon Lottery Corner. I'm Rarity, your attendant today.
en: This is the Pokémon Lottery Corner. I'm Rarity, your attendant today.
ja: ここはポケモン宝くじコーナーです。本日の係員、レアリティです。

key: If the drawn number matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon, you could win fabulous gifts.
en: If the drawn number matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon, you could win fabulous gifts.
ja: 引いた番号が、お手持ちのポケモンのID番号と一致すれば、素敵な景品がもらえますよ。

key: Would you like to check today's lucky number?
en: Would you like to check today's lucky number?
ja: 本日のラッキーナンバーを確認しますか?

key: First, I'll look up today's Pokémon Lottery Corner lucky number.
en: First, I'll look up today's Pokémon Lottery Corner lucky number.
ja: まず、本日のポケモン宝くじコーナーのラッキーナンバーを調べますね。

key: Your Lotto Ticket number is \v[1].
en: Your Lotto Ticket number is \v[1].
ja: あなたの宝くじ番号は\v[1]です。

key: Now, let's see if it matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon.
en: Now, let's see if it matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon.
ja: それでは、お手持ちのポケモンのID番号と一致するか確認しましょう。

key: I'm sorry. You didn't get a match...
en: I'm sorry. You didn't get a match...
ja: 残念、一致しませんでした……

key: Please do visit again.
en: Please do visit again.
ja: またのご来店をお待ちしております。

key: Congratulations!
en: Congratulations!
ja: おめでとうございます!

key: The ID number of your team's \v[2] matches your Lotto Ticket number!
en: The ID number of your team's \v[2] matches your Lotto Ticket number!
ja: 手持ちの\v[2]のID番号が、宝くじ番号と一致しました!

key: The ID number of your PC-boxed \v[2] matches your Lotto Ticket number!
en: The ID number of your PC-boxed \v[2] matches your Lotto Ticket number!
ja: ボックス内の\v[2]のID番号が、宝くじ番号と一致しました!

key: Oh my goodness, all five digits matched!
en: Oh my goodness, all five digits matched!
ja: なんと、5桁すべて一致です!

key: You've won the jackpot prize!
en: You've won the jackpot prize!
ja: 大当たり賞のプレゼントです!

key: Please do visit again! Good-bye from Rarity, your attendant!
en: Please do visit again! Good-bye from Rarity, your attendant!
ja: またのご来店をお待ちしております! 係員のレアリティでした!

key: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
en: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
ja: \r空きがありません。スペースを空けてから、またお越しください。

key: The last four digits matched, so you win the first prize!
en: The last four digits matched, so you win the first prize!
ja: 下4桁が一致したので、1等のプレゼントです!

key: You have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
en: You have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
ja: 空きがありません。スペースを空けてから、またお越しください。

key: The last three digits matched, so you win the second prize!
en: The last three digits matched, so you win the second prize!
ja: 下3桁が一致したので、2等のプレゼントです!

key: The last two digits matched, so you win the third prize!
en: The last two digits matched, so you win the third prize!
ja: 下2桁が一致したので、3等のプレゼントです!

key: The last digit matched, so you win the fourth prize!
en: The last digit matched, so you win the fourth prize!
ja: 下1桁が一致したので、4等のプレゼントです!

key: Oh, I see.\nPlease do visit us again.
en: Oh, I see.\nPlease do visit us again.
ja: そうですか。\nまたのご来店をお待ちしております。

key: You've already drawn a Lotto Ticket today. Please come back tomorrow.
en: You've already drawn a Lotto Ticket today. Please come back tomorrow.
ja: 本日はもう宝くじを引いていますよ。また明日いらしてください。

key: I've been waiting for you. Here's the item you won.
en: I've been waiting for you. Here's the item you won.
ja: お待ちしておりました。当選した景品をどうぞ。

key: Why is the game down...
en: Why is the game down...
ja: 何でゲームが止まってるんだよ……

key: My life has no meaning without online games.
en: My life has no meaning without online games.
ja: オンラインゲームがなきゃ、俺の人生に意味なんてない。

key: I will be the best!!!
en: I will be the best!!!
ja: 俺が絶対トップになってやる!!!

key: ...When the PvP system is back.
en: ...When the PvP system is back.
ja: ……対戦システムが復活したらな。

key: Yes! I finally got promoted to Crystal!
en: Yes! I finally got promoted to Crystal!
ja: よし! やっとクリスタルに昇格した!

key: I'll just gamble my life away until the real game is back.
en: I'll just gamble my life away until the real game is back.

key: I don't even care if I win or not. Here, have some coins.
en: I don't even care if I win or not. Here, have some coins.
ja: 勝っても負けてもどうでもいいや。ほら、コインやるよ。

key: \PN received 130 coins!
en: \PN received 130 coins!
ja: \PNはコインを130枚もらった!

key: All the regulars here are sad 'cuz their arcade game is down.
en: All the regulars here are sad 'cuz their arcade game is down.
ja: 常連はみんな、ゲームが止まってて悲しんでるよ。

key: Me? I got a better game right here. It's called Pokémon Reborn.
en: Me? I got a better game right here. It's called Pokémon Reborn.
ja: 俺? 俺にはもっといいゲームがあるんだ。ポケモンリボーンっていうんだけどな。

key: You probably haven't heard of it.
en: You probably haven't heard of it.
ja: たぶん聞いたことないだろうけど。

key: The server is offline, and right when I had almost earned enough points to buy a new champion...
en: The server is offline, and right when I had almost earned enough points to buy a new champion...
ja: サーバーが落ちてるんだよ、あと少しで新しいチャンピオンが買えるポイントが貯まりそうだったのに……

key: Here you can buy coins to play our games and win fabulous prizes!
en: Here you can buy coins to play our games and win fabulous prizes!
ja: ここではゲームで遊んで素敵な景品が当たるコインを購入できますよ!

key: Coins can be purchased at 50 for $1000 or 500 for $10,000.
en: Coins can be purchased at 50 for $1000 or 500 for $10,000.
ja: コインは$1000で50枚、$10,000で500枚購入できます。

key: \G\CNWould you like to buy some coins?
en: \G\CNWould you like to buy some coins?
ja: \G\CNコインを購入しますか?

key: Thank you very much!
en: Thank you very much!
ja: 誠にありがとうございます!

key: I'm afraid you don't have the cash. Please come back soon!
en: I'm afraid you don't have the cash. Please come back soon!

key: Enjoy the games!
en: Enjoy the games!

key: Oh, I'm sorry. In order to purchase coins, you must have a Coin Case first. Please return as soon as you obtain one!
en: Oh, I'm sorry. In order to purchase coins, you must have a Coin Case first. Please return as soon as you obtain one!
ja: あら、申し訳ありません。コインを購入するには、まずコインケースが必要です。手に入れ次第、またお越しください!

key: Hello! Here, you can exchange your coins for fantastic prizes!
en: Hello! Here, you can exchange your coins for fantastic prizes!

key: Which would you like?
en: Which would you like?
